steps.ask: Why do pictures help me remember?

faq.a: It is a card with two pictures. Now shows what is happening right now. Next shows what comes after.

faq.q: Why do pictures help me remember?
faq.a: Pictures stay still, so you can look again whenever you need. Spoken words disappear quickly.

faq.q: Where should I put visual reminders?
faq.a: Where you need them: by the door for your bag, on your desk for your day, by your bed for bedtime.

faq.q: Can I make my own pictures?
faq.a: Yes. Draw them, cut them from magazines or print them. A grown-up you trust can help you make them.

faq.q: Is a now-next board the same as first-then?
faq.a: They are similar. Now-next shows what is happening and what follows. First-then often has a job first, then a fun thing.

facts: Visual supports, like picture schedules, are used in many schools around the world.
A picture can be looked at again and again, but spoken words are gone once said.

quiz.say: On a now-next board, what does next show?
quiz.why: Next shows what comes after the now picture.

wrong.1: The board shows now and next, not yesterday.
wrong.2: Next always shows what comes after.
